# Permit Acquisition
1. The requester delivers a filled permit form for contraband to the Warden, the Head of Security, or in an emergency, the Captain. The requester may also ask for an empty permit to fill, and may return after filling it out. The equipment they are requesting a permit for should be kept in a secure area in the meantime. The permit must contain the Time and Date, the requester's name and their position, a valid reason for the permit, and how the item will be or has already been obtained.
Any chemical which requires a prescription must provide a valid prescription with the permit that is signed or stamped appropriately.
2. A permit should be reviewed to evaluate the validity and necessity of the request.
- If the item requires delivery by a department other than Security, the permit must already be signed or stamped by the [color=#ffe100]relevant Command member[/color]. - If the permit requires a Security item that is in limited stock it may be denied until more can be obtained. The reason for denial must be clearly stated. - If the requester has already received a related permit the reviewer may choose to deny the permit unless the old permit and contraband are turned in. - [color=#8d281e]Highly illegal contraband[/color] is [color=#ff0000]never[/color] to be approved by the Security department. The approval of such contraband is the jurisdiction of Central Command alone. - Permits for Armory equipment are not to be issued below [color=#2a6099]Code Blue[/color], with the sole exception of to [color=#875d3c]Salvagers[/color] with authorisation solely for off-station encounters.
3. If the request is not unreasonable, it should be stamped as [color=#00a933]APPROVED[/color], as well as signed and stamped by the reviewer it. If the request is unreasonable it should be stamped as [color=#ff0000]DENIED[/color] instead.
4. Copies of the permit should be made for the Warden and Head of Security, to be kept in a secure location.
5. Permits are to be returned to the requester after processing. Approved permits are to be kept on hand by the permitted individual at all times. Denied permits must be returned with a brief explanation as to why, followed by the recovery of any contraband if it has already been acquired.
